title: Human Index photographic portfolio layout
intent: Photography and public interfaces make situated work credible while remaining public-safe, accessible, project-specific, and subordinate to human publication authority.

hiringArgument.selectionBasis: Use the deterministic public-resume opportunity set when no authorized private active-application IDs are supplied. Re-evaluate this sequence before hiring-reader role play whenever that set, a project's proof strength, or a project's truthful cover changes.
hiringArgument.sequenceLogic: Lead with current role relevance and direct evidence, then widen the case through sustained client stewardship, field implementation and resource responsibility, platform scale, and human-centered continuity.

criteria.criterion: Every public photograph is registered once with stable dimensions, alt text, caption, credit, placement, status, permission, and interpretation boundary.
A photograph without a confirmed individual creator uses concise project-centered courtesy language; visitor-facing credits never expose archive-processing uncertainty.

The launch candidate uses exactly five reviewed photographs: the unchanged East River hero, the Shoestring Press and Market Hotel evidence sequence, the Sunday Dinner cover, and the KC Town Hall cover.
Public assets and source code contain no EXIF payload, private archive UUID, original camera filename, People metadata, GPS data, or protected filesystem path.
The homepage photograph remains unchanged; the Fair Rent sequence retains facilitation, shared public infrastructure, and collective public action; About and Colophon remain text-led.

Every work item has one project-specific cover: KC Spaces Fund, Harry J. Epstein, CallNYC, and WOW List use their own public surfaces; Fair Rent NYC, Sunday Dinner, and KC Town Hall use governed photographs.

The homepage hiring argument identifies the exact deterministic live opportunity set that informed its project selection. If that set changes, the project sequence becomes stale and hiring-reader role play is blocked until the argument is reviewed.

The homepage presents six projects in a deliberate hiring sequence for the current live opportunity set: present-day NYC Artist Coalition civic operations; direct resident-facing product work through CallNYC; long-term Harry J. Epstein client stewardship; KC Town Hall field implementation, resource responsibility, and resident service; WOW List platform scale; then Sunday Dinner and 196 onboarding, facilitation, and continuity. Sunday Dinner remains a required homepage project. Harry J. Epstein does not lead while its cover is explicitly a successor site rather than Jamie's implementation.
Every tag-shaped control is a keyboard-reachable link to a visible filtered work-index state, with a clear route back to the complete index.
Every homepage capability row is a full-row keyboard-reachable link to the filtered work index, uses a tag present in project data, and follows the same index interaction grammar as Start here.
The Human Index palette is active and gradients, decorative orbs, and bokeh are absent.
Images use Next Image, explicit intrinsic dimensions or fill, stable aspect ratios, responsive sizes, and a viewport-bounded hero.
Reviewed local image derivatives bypass runtime optimization on the single-CPU Dokku app and remain small enough for direct delivery.
Design and Knowledge Wiki records state that automated scores and staging review do not replace rights, dignity, attribution, exact-candidate production approval, or indexing approval.
